paper.title: A simple lattice Boltzmann model for turbulence Rayleigh–Bénard thermal convection
paper.local_pdf: /Users/Admin/Documents/References/05_论文原文PDF/Yikun Wei-Hua-Shu Dou and Yuehong Qian-2015-A simple lattice Boltzmann model for turbulence Rayleigh-Benard thermal convection.pdf

method.flow: Wei D2Q9 BGK with explicit Fi=3wi*rho*gBeta*T*ciy
method.velocity: raw sum(ci*f)/rho; no Guo prefactor or half-step correction; initial f=feq
method.equilibrium_completion: standard second-order D2Q9 polynomial for rho and T, supported by Wei ref10 Shan1997 Eq2 but not explicitly printed by Wei
method.transport_completion: nu=(tauf-.5)/3 and kappa=(taug-.5)/3, Shan1997 Eq7 and Eq10 with zero self interaction
method.walls: Project half-link BB/ABB/specular; closed RB side adiabatic and side-heated case are adaptations
method.restart: scheme WEI_BGK_2D_V1, metadata1004,14parameters, f/g and steady reference fields, strict Nu/Re timeline

completion_source.paper: Xiaowen Shan (1997), Simulation of Rayleigh-Benard convection using a lattice Boltzmann method
completion_source.qualification: supports explicit equilibrium/transport completion; Shan velocity-shift force was not imported

known_benchmark_difference: Low-Ra 32² side-heated Nu1.11562330 vs Wang1.1178, relative0.19473%; finite-grid/explicit-forcing effects possible but cause not established; not a reported Wei Nu target
